verdict.rationale: Rootly documents deep two-way operation in Slack and Microsoft Teams: you can declare, run and resolve incidents there, and acknowledge, escalate and resolve pages in Teams. Jira is covered by workflow actions and an AI connector that looks up related issues, but nothing shows Jira state syncing back into Rootly. Zoom and GitHub are never named; there are only generic mentions of bridge calls and code connectors. missing for 10: Zoom integration evidence, GitHub integration evidence, documented bidirectional Jira sync, independent/hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an SRE, the platform integrates with the tools around the incident — Jira, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub — so state flows both ways
